The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II describes the considered MA-enabled FH-MIMO radar system model and the corresponding ambiguity function. In Section III, we analyze the relationship between the ambiguity function and the antenna positions. In Section IV, we propose a low complexity algorithm to solve the antenna position optimization problem. Section V provides the numerical results and discussions. Finally, we conclude this paper in Section VI. Notations: Scalars, vectors and matrices are respectively denoted by lower/upper case, boldface lower case and boldface upper case letters.
